import html # Template for rendering a blog post on the web page. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely for display on a web page. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content/body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string that can be safely inserted into a page. Raises ------ TypeError If either title or body is not a string. """ if not isinstance(title, str): raise TypeError("title must be a string") if not isinstance(body, str): raise TypeError("body must be a string") # Escape user input to prevent XSS and ensure well‑formed HTML safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized values into the template rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered.strip()
